integrity.claim_scope: Exact coupling-resonance classification, dark dimension, mixed and site-specific eventual absorption probabilities, one joint theorem
integrity.proof_type: Analytic Fourier, cyclotomic independence, dissipative spectral projection

scientific_limitations: Odd prime cyclic size at least five; no assertion for composite sizes
Exactly two distinct absorbing sites with positive rates, no other dissipators
Positive uniform first- and second-neighbor hopping; coherent one-excitation, infinite-time limit
No finite-time uniform decay rate as a coupling crosses a resonance
title: Isolated two-sink capture resonances on prime cyclic quantum networks
